name: meter
description: A side pane that shows context fill, rate-limit burn pace, cost and the largest context categories, drawn outside the model's context.

meterAutoOpen.title: Open the meter pane at session start
meterAutoOpen.description: The pane is placed at session start only on a terminal 144 columns wide or more. Narrower, run /meter to open it.

meterGlyphs.title: Meter glyph set
meterGlyphs.description: unicode draws in any font. nerd draws Nerd Font icons, which show as boxes without a patched font.
